summary: The filing is a Form 8-K with Item 8.01 (Other Events), reporting an increase in the offering price per share of the company's Class B Common Stock from $15.90 to $16.05 effective August 7, 2026. This is a routine administrative update to a continuous offering, not a special situation event. The filing includes standard forward-looking statements and was executed by the General Counsel. No special-situation characteristics are present; this is an ordinary securities offering price adjustment.
